title: EnginePluginManifest
description: What a plugin's manifest declares, read fresh (plan 13, B-27): names only, never the content of a hook or a command — reading further than that would be interpreting a format of the engine's own.

mcpServerNames.description: Only the names the plugin's own manifest or `.mcp.json` declares — never the full configuration: a plugin's MCP servers never run on their own (`skipMcpDiscovery: true`), so there is nothing here to approve from, only to see.
